images.name: cover
images.prompt: Cinematic night photograph, magazine-ad quality, fine film grain. A student seen from behind and slightly to the side sits at a wooden desk by a large window at night; an open laptop on the desk glows with a simple abstract bar chart of soft green bars, the only strong light in the room, lighting the student's shoulders and a mug and notebook on the desk. Blurred warm city lights through the window. The student and desk sit in the lower 60% of the frame; the top 35% is dark, plain night wall and window with nothing in it. Portrait 2:3, natural colours, not tinted green overall. No readable text, no letters, no numbers, no logos, no faces, no watermark.
